content: Privacy Policy Last updated: Feb 20, 2026 This page explains how stay foolish stay hungry (“this site”) collects, uses, and protects your information when you visit.
title: Privacy Policy

content: Information We Collect
title: Privacy Policy

content: Automatically collected When you visit this site, the server and analytics services may automatically log: IP address (used for regional statistics, anonymized or truncated) Browser type and version Operating system Access time and pages visited Referrer information
title: Privacy Policy

content: Information you provide When you interact with this site (e.g. comments, email), you may submit information such as your name, email, and message content.
title: Privacy Policy

content: How We Use Information Collected information is used only for: Improving site content and user experience Analyzing traffic trends (via Google Analytics) Responding to your feedback and inquiries Preventing abuse and fraud
title: Privacy Policy

content: Cookies and Third-Party Services
title: Privacy Policy

content: Google Analytics This site uses Google Analytics to understand traffic. Google places cookies in your browser to collect anonymized data. Please see Google’s privacy and terms for details. You can opt out of personalized advertising at Google Ads Settings.
title: Privacy Policy

content: Third-party ads After this site passes the Google AdSense review, Google-provided ads may be displayed. Google uses cookies based on your prior visits to this and other sites to serve ads. You can manage or disable personalized ads at Google Ads Settings.
title: Privacy Policy

content: Opting out You can disable cookies in your browser, but some features may not work as expected.
title: Privacy Policy

content: Information Sharing I do not sell or trade your personal information. Disclosure to third parties only happens when: Required by law Necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of this site or the public In the event of a merger, acquisition, or asset sale
title: Privacy Policy

content: Data Security This site uses reasonable safeguards to protect your information: HTTPS encryption, anonymized analytics, and restricted admin access.
title: Privacy Policy

content: Your Rights Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to: Access, correct, or delete personal information I hold about you Withdraw consent or restrict processing Request data portability To exercise these rights, please contact me using the email below.
title: Privacy Policy

content: Children’s Privacy This site is intended for engineers and is not directed to children under 13. I do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
title: Privacy Policy

content: External Links This site may link to third-party sites (such as GitHub and Google services). I cannot control and am not responsible for their privacy practices.
title: Privacy Policy

content: Policy Changes I may update this privacy policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date on this page indicates when the policy was last revised.
title: Privacy Policy

content: Contact If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact me at: Email: hnwolf@gmail.com GitHub: hnboy
title: Privacy Policy

content: Governing Law This privacy policy is governed by the laws of the People’s Republic of China.
title: Privacy Policy

content: About stay foolish stay hungry stay foolish stay hungry is a personal technical blog written by WQ (hnboy), an electronics engineer working on NAND flash memory, embedded systems, and Linux desktop tooling.
title: About

content: What you’ll find here Hardware & Storage: ONFI spec notes, NAND signal integrity, HBM/HBF packaging, PCIe/NVMe integration Embedded Linux: Arch Linux setup, KDE/Wayland tips, package management (pacman, yay, Docker) Web Development: TypeScript, schema validation (Zod), and tooling for technical writing Most articles started as my own working notes. I publish them in the hope they help other engineers who run into the same problems.
